projects.name: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Predict customer churn for proactive retention strategies.

content.problem: Telecom companies face significant challenges with customer attrition. It is difficult to identify customers who are likely to leave, making it hard to implement timely retention strategies.

dataset.Description: IBM's sample data module tracks a fictional telco company's customer churn based on various factors. The dataset includes key columns such as churn (indicating if a customer departed in the last month), gender, dependents, monthly charges, and service details.

content.solution: Built a predictive model using data cleaning, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and classification algorithms (logistic regression, decision trees, and random forests) to accurately forecast customer churn within two weeks.
content.impact: Accurate churn prediction allows businesses to develop targeted retention strategies, reducing customer loss and increasing revenue while enhancing overall customer relationship management.

projects.name: Repeat Customer Prediction
projects.description: Identify customers likely to make repeat purchases.

content.problem: Businesses struggle to pinpoint which customers will make repeat purchases, hindering the effectiveness of targeted marketing campaigns.

dataset.Description: The dataset comprises 50,000 customer transactions from Walmart, including demographic details, product categories, purchase amounts, discounts, and ratings, capturing consumer shopping behavior.

content.solution: Conducted extensive data analysis and segmentation to understand shopping patterns and built classification models to predict repeat customer behavior.
content.impact: This framework enables personalized marketing strategies, optimizing customer retention and achieving higher ROI on marketing expenditures while refining customer segmentation.

content.problem: Providing personalized movie recommendations is challenging due to the need to match content with both historical preferences and current moods.

dataset.Description: The Netflix dataset contains detailed movie information, including release year, duration, cast, summaries, ratings, subtitles, audio languages, and viewer mood.

content.solution: Designed a recommendation system that integrates content-based and collaborative filtering techniques, leveraging natural language processing to analyze movie summaries and metadata for mood alignment.
content.impact: Enhances user engagement by providing smarter, mood-aware recommendations, leading to longer viewing sessions, higher retention, and a competitive edge in the streaming market.

projects.name: Predicting Employee Churn Early On
projects.description: Identify early signs of employee attrition to reduce turnover.

content.problem: Employee turnover is costly and disruptive. Early identification of factors leading to employee churn is crucial for timely interventions and retention strategies.

dataset.Description: Created by IBM data scientists, this dataset provides insights into employee churn with variables related to work-life balance, compensation, job satisfaction, and other attrition drivers.

content.solution: Conducted an in-depth analysis using classification algorithms with rigorous feature engineering and model tuning to predict employee churn early and highlight key drivers of attrition.
content.impact: Enables organizations to implement targeted interventions and engagement programs, reducing turnover costs and ensuring a more stable, productive workforce.

projects.name: Yelp Reviews EDA and Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: Analyze Yelp reviews to extract actionable customer insights.

content.problem: Extracting actionable insights from large volumes of user-generated content is challenging, requiring advanced NLP techniques to understand customer sentiment and trends.

dataset.Description: The Yelp Open Dataset is a subset of Yelp's business data including reviews, photos, check-ins, and additional attributes such as hours, parking availability, and ambience.

content.solution: Conducted exploratory data analysis on 8,000 Yelp reviews and developed a sentiment analysis pipeline by benchmarking BERT against other leading LLMs to classify reviews and extract human-readable topics.
content.impact: Provides rapid, detailed customer insights that drive timely operational adjustments, improved customer service, and more informed decision-making.

projects.name: RAG-Enhanced LLM for Classified Information Detection
projects.description: Automate document classification to detect sensitive information.

content.problem: Manual document review for classified information is labor-intensive and error-prone, posing significant risks to organizations handling sensitive data.

dataset.Description: Utilizes synthetic data generated via fine-tuned Ollama models to simulate various document types containing classified information, supplemented with industry-relevant examples.
dataset.Source: Synthetic data generated using fine-tuned Ollama models

content.solution: Developed a document classification pipeline integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with a fine-tuned distilbert-base-uncased model. This approach uses synthetic data to accurately detect documents containing classified content.
content.impact: Streamlines the document review process, significantly enhancing data security and operational efficiency. This leads to rapid, reliable detection of sensitive information and ensures regulatory compliance.
